xykDescription: Runs a constant product-based market making strategy on the {{pair}} market. Yield is generated from limit order spreads.
xykWithdrawalInfo: Liquidity providers may withdraw their liquidity at any time. There is no lockup period.
lendingDescription: Generate passive returns by lending {{symbol}}, with a relatively low risk profile (all loans are overcollateralized) and no exposure to Impermanent Loss. The yield comes from borrowers which are charged an interest rate every block based on the utilization rate of the borrowed asset compared to the total supplied available for lending.
lendingWithdrawalInfo: Lenders may withdraw their liquidity at any time, as long as asset utilization remains under 100%. If utilization reaches 100%, lenders' funds will be unavailable until debts are repaid or further deposits made to the pool.
thorchainClpDescription: Provides liquidity to THORChain {{pair}} Continuous Liquidity Pools on the Base Layer, using a constant product (XYX) bonding curve. Yield is generated from a dynamic slip-based fee, which increases alongside the size of the swaps relative to the total liquidity in the pool. LPs in the pools also receive a share of the Rujira revenue that is sent to THORChain. The slip-based fee and Rujira's revenue are distributed between LPs and THORChain Node Operators depending on the state of the {{incentivePendulum}}. The share going to LPs is then distributed between each pool proportionally to their contribution to the total slip-based fees.
thorchainDepositInfo: Unlike other strategies on Rujira, depositing in THORChain Base Layer Pools is a two-step process requiring to sign a transaction for each of the two assets deposited.

perpsRiskPriceP1: Liquidity providers act as the counterparty to every trade on the platform. This means when a trader opens a long, it's as if the LP pool is opening a short of the same size—and vice versa. If the market moves in the trader's favor (e.g., a long position profits as prices rise), the LP pool absorbs the loss. This can lead to principal impairment, especially in markets with unbalanced net open interest (e.g., more longs than shorts).
perpsRiskPriceP2: The protocol attempts to minimize price risk through: Delta-neutral incentives (funding rate payments, basis trading), Dynamic borrow fees to balance supply and demand, and Internal controls on max gain collateral locking per position.
perpsRiskPriceP3: However, if these mechanisms fail to fully offset directional risk—especially in cases of extreme market movements or persistent imbalance in trader positions—LPs and xPL holders remain exposed to substantial losses. In the worst-case scenario, this can result in a total loss of capital (up to 100%).
perpsRiskLockup: LP token withdrawals are subject to a 24-hour delay. During this period, capital remains exposed to market movements and trader activity. xLP tokens have a 45-day unbinding period. This means you cannot access your capital for 45 days after requesting withdrawal, as so you are exposed to extended periods of price risk in the pool. In return for the extended lockup and added risk, xLP holders receive a larger share of fees and rewards.
